map.：比值=1.5/3.0=50%<0.7→阻塞性；FVC%pred≥80 不支持限: Ratio = 1.5/3.0 = 50% < 0.7 -> obstructive; FVC%pred >= 80 does not support restriction.
map.：比值正常但 FVC%pred<80→限制性通气障碍，查 TLC。: A normal ratio with FVC%pred < 80 -> restrictive ventilatory dysfunction, check TLC.
